title: 12 Viridian Park Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 12 Viridian Park Drive is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Experience the best of WaterColor living at 12 Viridian Park Drive, a luxurious retreat in the Park District offering timeless design, exceptional comfort, and resort-style amenities. With a private pool and spa, multiple living areas, and close proximity to the Beach Club and Seaside, this home delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and recreation for your next 30A getaway.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Private Pool and Spa (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Exterior Shower Multiple Living Areas Spacious Outdoor Entertainment Area with Natural Gas Grill Steps to WaterColor Tennis Center 2-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside 3-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access 4-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Camp WaterColor Experience the Home Welcome to 12 Viridian Park Drive, a beautifully designed WaterColor retreat where coastal luxury meets laid-back comfort. This spacious four-bedroom home with a loft accommodates up to ten guests and offers an ideal setting for families or groups seeking privacy and convenience. The open-concept great room on the first-floor features soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, and abundant natural light. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with Viking appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar for casual dining. The adjacent dining area seats thirteen, providing plenty of room for family meals and celebrations. The main level also includes a queen bedroom with a private bath and direct access to the outdoor patio. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite offers a king bed, spa-style bathroom, and private balcony overlooking the pool. A second king suite and a queen guest bedroom, each with private baths, ensure all guests enjoy comfort and privacy. On the third floor, a loft area with a full sleeper sofa and twin sleeper provides extra space for kids or additional guests. Step outside to enjoy your own private oasis. The outdoor living area includes a pool and spa, lounge seating, and a built-in gas grill surrounded by lush landscaping. Whether swimming, dining al fresco, or relaxing poolside, this home invites you to enjoy WaterColor’s outdoor beauty. With four adult bikes included, exploring the community and nearby Seaside is simple and fun. 12 Viridian Park Drive is the perfect choice for those seeking a spacious, stylish home close to all of WaterColor’s premier amenities. Please note: The indoor fireplace and outdoor fire pit are unavailable for guest use.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Third Floor: Loft Area: Full Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) and Twin Sleeper (Sleeps 1) Life in WaterColor Located steps from the Tennis Center and just minutes from Seaside, Camp WaterColor, and the Beach Club, 12 Viridian Park Drive offers easy access to all the community’s best features. With a private pool, bikes, and spacious indoor and outdoor areas, this home provides everything you need for a relaxing and memorable WaterColor vacation. Guests may rent a cart exclusively through The Electric Cart Company. Please note that WaterColor allows only one electric cart per home, and rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially during peak seasons.
rooms_guidance: Third Floor Loft Area | 1 Futon, 1 Sleep Sofa
